name: holo-js-monorepo
description: Holo-JS Framework - configurable backend runtime for Nuxt, Next.js, and SvelteKit

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:libraries && bun run typecheck:tests
scripts.test: bun run test:dependency-policy && bun run --workspaces --if-present --sequential test
scripts.test:cli:coverage: rm -rf coverage/cli && HOLO_CLI_INCLUDE_INTEGRATION=1 bun run --cwd packages/cli test -- --coverage --coverage.clean=false --coverage.reportsDirectory='../../coverage/cli' --coverage.include='src/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/**/types.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/cli-types.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/bin/**' --pool forks
scripts.test:examples: bun run test:example:blog-nuxt && bun run test:example:blog-next && bun run test:example:blog-sveltekit
scripts.test:config:coverage: rm -rf coverage/config && bun run --cwd packages/config test -- --coverage --coverage.clean=false --coverage.reportsDirectory='../../coverage/config' --coverage.include='src/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/**/types.ts'
scripts.test:core:coverage: rm -rf coverage/core && bun run --cwd packages/core test -- --coverage --coverage.clean=false --coverage.reportsDirectory='../../coverage/core' --coverage.include='src/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/**/types.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/runtime/**/*.d.ts'
scripts.test:db:coverage: rm -rf coverage/db && bun run --cwd packages/db test -- --coverage --coverage.clean=false --coverage.reportsDirectory='../../coverage/db' --coverage.include='src/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/**/types.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/migrations/templates/**' --coverage.exclude='src/drivers/index.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/drivers/SQLiteAdapter.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/drivers/PostgresAdapter.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/drivers/MySQLAdapter.ts'
scripts.test:events:coverage: rm -rf coverage/events && bun run --cwd packages/events test -- --coverage --coverage.clean=false --coverage.reportsDirectory='../../coverage/events' --coverage.include='src/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='src/**/types.ts'
